- Confirmed via direct filesystem check (not just reading the chat): none of `AutoTagger.swift`, `BacklinkQuery.swift`, or `SearchRelevanceScorer.swift` exist anywhere in `app_build` — same as last round, this is narrative output from the Qwen fallback, not committed code. Flagging again so it isn't mistaken for progress.
- If it *were* applied, `BacklinkQuery` is written against **CoreData** (`Entry.fetchRequest()`, `NSPredicate`) — this is a SwiftData app end to end. Same framework confusion as last round's `Entry` snippet, now a second file.
- More serious than the framework mismatch: `isBroken` reads `mention.targetEntry` as if it were a relationship. The contract deliberately makes `Mention.targetEntryID` a raw `UUID`, *not* a relationship (DEC-tech_specs-005), specifically so a deleted target can be detected — this snippet would silently defeat the entire mechanism it's supposed to implement.
- `isBroken`'s logic is also wrong on its own terms: it flags a mention as broken whenever the target `isDemo`, which has nothing to do with whether the entry exists. Demo entries would incorrectly show broken-link styling everywhere.
- `SearchRelevanceScorer` drops two required parts of the locked formula (DEC-tech_specs-006): no +5 contiguous-phrase bonus, and `recencyBonus` is hardcoded to `0.0` with a comment saying so. That formula's exact weights are the specific thing DEC-app_features-003 gated as a binary pass/fail — this doesn't clear it.
- `SearchRelevanceScorer` also always returns `matchReasons: []`. My `SearchResultRow` reads that array to render the "matched via transcript/tag/mood" hint (DEC-design_discussion-007) — with this, every result would show no reason at all.
- `AutoTagger` did land in the right shape this time (`enum`/static, not last round's `struct`/instance) — but `moodScore` isn't implemented at all this round, and the snippet's `text[range] as? String` is an invalid cast (`Substring` isn't downcastable to `String`) that wouldn't compile anyway.
- Third distinct file-path convention now (`src/services/...`, joining root `Features/` and `Fieldnotes/Features/`) on top of a third straight round with no real data_domain/services_utilities code on disk — agree with Claude B that this is now a structural call for the orchestrator, not something either frontend lane can keep absorbing.
